votes.motion: Commissioner Swanson moved to APPROVE the Minutes of the February 19, 2025 Planning Commission Meeting, as presented

Commissioner Swanson moved to forward a POSITIVE recommendation to the City Council for the Proposed Land Use Ordinance Text Amendment to Section 11.120.060 to Allow Gravel Parking Lots for Conditional Uses

Commissioner Luker moved to forward a NEGATIVE recommendation to the City Council for the Proposed Land Use Ordinance Text Amendment to Section 11.120.060 to Allow Gravel Parking Lots for Conditional Uses based on the following findings: 1. The Text Amendment would apply to all zones that allow the Outdoor Recreation and Entertainment Use. 2. It is not in alignment with the City's vision

Commissioner Luker moved to forward a NEGATIVE recommendation to the City Council for the Proposed Land Use Ordinance Text Amendment to Section 11.120.060 to Allow Gravel Parking Lots for Conditional Uses based on the following findings: 1. The Text Amendment should restrict gravel surfaces to the Heavy Commercial (HC)Zone. 2. As written,the Text Amendment is not in alignment with the City's vision for all affected zones
